$description: High contrast, in either colour scheme: the background, text, lines and accent at the scheme's strongest, the line and the text of each colour family's hue too.

background.$description: The page at the scheme's strongest: pure white, or pure black in dark.

text-primary.$description: Text at the scheme's strongest against the page.

text-secondary.$description: Text that steps back, still well past 7 to 1, so stepping back never costs a reader who needs contrast (WCAG 2, 1.4.6).

accent.$description: The accent a step deeper in light, and lighter in dark.

line.$description: Every line as strong as the text, so a part's edge shows for a reader who cannot tell faint greys apart.

family.$description: Each hue's line and text at their strongest steps, so a family's marks hold against its fill.
